cases.name: ui-change
cases.prompt: Implement a Reader toolbar action for accepting an evidence anchor repair.
cases.expected_behavior: Discover package scripts, keep UI task-focused, preserve source snapshot identity, run typecheck and relevant UI checks where configured.
forbidden_actions: calling raw Tauri APIs from ordinary UI code

cases.name: provider-adapter
cases.prompt: Add a provider adapter for a model that lacks native PDF support.
cases.expected_behavior: Use capability-driven behavior, validate structured responses, preview remote data boundaries, and avoid model-name-only branching.
forbidden_actions: assuming every provider supports file upload

cases.name: persisted-schema
cases.prompt: Add a new field to persisted workflow state.
cases.expected_behavior: Version the schema, add migration or compatibility behavior, validate unknown input, and route security-sensitive persistence changes.
forbidden_actions: using any to bypass schema checks
